description: Search goldenpages.ie (Ireland's business directory) by category or keyword and county, city or town, or fetch full business profiles from direct goldenpages.ie URLs.

businessUrls.description: Direct goldenpages.ie URLs: a business profile, an advanced-search results page, or a category browse page. Profile URLs return one full record each; listing URLs are paginated. Use the sourceUrl from search results.

url.description: goldenpages.ie business, search or category URL.
url.title: URL

businessUrls.title: goldenpages.ie URLs

category.description: A common Irish business category. Choose 'Custom category' and type your own below if it is not listed.
category.title: Category

county.description: An Irish county, 'Nationwide', or 'Custom location' to type a city or town below.
county.title: County / location

customCategory.description: Free-text category or keyword not in the list above, e.g. 'locksmith' or 'IT services'. Takes priority over Category when set (unless Categories or keywords is used).
customCategory.title: Custom category or keyword

customLocation.description: Free-text city, town or Dublin postal area, e.g. 'Blanchardstown', 'Dun Laoghaire' or 'Dublin 15'. Takes priority over County / location when set (unless Counties, cities or towns is used).
customLocation.title: Custom location (city or town)

includeDetails.description: Also open each business's profile page to read its published email, FAQ, full description and photo gallery. Slower; auto-enabled by 'Only businesses with an email'.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full profiles (email, FAQs, gallery)

latitude.description: Latitude of a search centre, e.g. 53.3498 for central Dublin. Supply together with longitude to add distanceKm and enable the radius filter.
latitude.title: Centre latitude

locations.description: One or more places, e.g. ["Dublin", "Cork"]. Each is combined with every category/keyword above. Use "ireland" for nationwide. When set, this overrides County and Custom location.
locations.title: Counties, cities or towns (multi-search)

longitude.description: Longitude of a search centre, e.g. -6.2603 for central Dublin. Supply together with latitude.
longitude.title: Centre longitude

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of business records to return. Large values take longer because each page carries 20 businesses.
maxItems.title: Max items

minRating.description: Keep only businesses rated at least this many stars. 0 means no minimum; businesses with no rating are excluded once this is above 0.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: What to fetch: search by category/keyword and location, or read the exact goldenpages.ie URLs you paste.
mode.title: Mode

radiusKm.description: Keep only businesses with coordinates within this many kilometres of the centre. 0 computes distanceKm without filtering. Businesses without published coordinates are skipped when a radius is set.
radiusKm.title: Radius (km)

rehostImages.description: Copy the logo and up to three gallery images into this run's key-value store and return public Apify URLs. Useful because GoldenPages' image CDN is region-restricted. Original URLs are kept in *Original fields.
rehostImages.title: Copy images to Apify storage

searchTerms.description: One or more business categories or keywords, e.g. ["restaurants", "hotels"]. Each is searched separately and combined with every location below. When set, this overrides Category and Custom category.
searchTerms.title: Categories or keywords (multi-search)

sortBy.description: How goldenpages.ie orders search results. Relevance is the most reliable; A-Z can include paid placements from other categories at the top.
sortBy.title: Sort order

strictCategoryMatch.description: Drop listings whose directory categories share no word with your search term. Use this with A-Z sort when paid placements from other categories appear; it can also drop legitimate pubs/cafes that the site files under a different category name.
strictCategoryMatch.title: Strict category matching

verifiedOnly.description: Keep only businesses with GoldenPages.ie's 'Verified' badge.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified listings only

withEmail.description: Drop records without a published email. This turns on detail enrichment automatically, so the profile page can be read for its email.
withEmail.title: Only businesses with an email

withOpeningHours.description: Drop records without published opening hours.
withOpeningHours.title: Only businesses with opening hours

withPhone.description: Drop records without a phone number.
withPhone.title: Only businesses with a phone

withWebsite.description: Drop records without a published website.
withWebsite.title: Only businesses with a website

title: GoldenPages Scraper Input
